name: Roasted Heirloom Tomato Soup with Coconut Milk
ingredients:
3 lb heirloom tomatoes, sliced
1 lb cherry tomatoes
2 bell peppers (different colors), sliced
1 white onion, chopped
1 bulb garlic, cloves separated and peeled
Olive oil
Salt
Black pepper
Dried basil
Dried thyme
Dried oregano
1 cup beef bone broth
1 (13.5 oz) can Thai coconut milk
Fresh basil, optional garnish
directions:
Preheat oven to 400°F. Arrange tomatoes, bell peppers, onion, and garlic on a baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt, pepper, basil, thyme, and oregano, and toss to coat.
Roast for about 60 minutes, until vegetables are soft and lightly caramelized.
Transfer roasted vegetables and their juices to a blender. Add bone broth and coconut milk and blend until smooth.
Pour into a pot and warm over low to medium heat for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Garnish with fresh basil if desired.
